title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
prompt:
Design a class that tracks the k-th largest element in a growing stream:

- `KthLargest(int k, int[] nums)` — initialize with existing numbers
- `int add(int val)` — append a value, return the current k-th largest

The size-k min-heap pattern, kept alive between calls as a field.

tests.note: starts empty; k=1 means simply the max

hints: Field: a min-heap holding the k largest values seen; its peek is the answer.
Constructor: just call your own add() for each initial number.
add: offer, poll if size > k, return peek.

solution.explanation: O(log k) per add. Reusing add() in the constructor keeps the invariant (heap holds exactly the top ≤ k) in one place — a pattern worth copying in design problems.
